articles.title: Foldable display access
articles.content:
## Inner display visible without touch
If the inner display is visible and inner display touch does not work, connect a USB mouse to navigate the device. If a USB mouse is available, use it to back up personal data.
## Inner display black
If the inner display is black, press and hold Power and Volume down for 20 seconds to force a restart. The cover screen may still work.
## Optional monitor
If the phone supports HDMI, connect a compatible monitor to view the image. Check compatibility before attempting this option.

articles.title: Bluetooth and scanning controls
articles.content:
## Bluetooth radio
To stop wireless pairing, disable Bluetooth in Settings.
## Bluetooth scanning
If background discovery is the problem, disable Bluetooth scanning in Settings.
## Physical check
Press the side key to restart the phone after checking the setting.

articles.title: Last resort data reset
articles.content:
## Backup before factory reset
A factory data reset is a last resort after previous troubleshooting failed. It will erase all personal data. Before proceeding, back up your personal data.
## Reset the device
After backup is complete, open Settings, select General management, then Reset, then Factory data reset. Tap Delete all to complete the reset.
## Auto factory reset information
Auto factory reset is a separate security setting. Do not enable it as a substitute for Factory data reset.
